blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings went from 54 to 53, and it took 25.9% of the city’s 116 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings went from 30 to 24, and it took 25.7% of the city’s 35 sales over the period.

The monthly write-ups singled out Scottsdale for detached houses in September (a sellers’ best bet); detached houses in July (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in July (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in August, September (a buyers’ best bet).

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Scottsdale than in June?
faq.a: Between June 2026 and September 2026, listings of houses fell from 54 to 53 and condos and townhomes fell from 30 to 24 in Scottsdale.

faq.q: How big is Scottsdale compared with the rest of North Delta?
faq.a: In September 2026, Scottsdale held 25.4% of the 209 houses listed in North Delta and 33.8% of the 71 condos and townhomes listed in North Delta.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Scottsdale from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 30 houses and 9 condos and townhomes sold in Scottsdale over those 4 months.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Scottsdale?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.
